About me

I'm a Project and Marketing Manager with over five years of experience across project management, marketing, customer care, and e-commerce. I work where people, processes, and business goals meet: bringing the right people together, creating structure, and moving ideas from planning to execution.

My Computer Science and Psychology background gives me two views. One is analytical, for systems and processes. The other is about people, communication, and consumer behavior.

How I work

Good delivery is about clarity: keeping people aligned, spotting problems early, and tying the work to the wider business goal.

1. Understand

Clarify the objective, the people involved, and what success looks like.

2. Structure

Turn requirements into priorities, responsibilities, and workflows.

3. Coordinate

Connect designers, developers, marketers, and clients.

4. Execute

Monitor progress and resolve bottlenecks.

5. Improve

Review what worked and refine the process.

Tregu i Librit: launching and scaling an online school-book marketplace

Project Manager, 07/2024 – present · three seasonal editions, 2024–2026

Parents in Kosovo couldn't find all the textbooks they needed in one place, and the lines at libraries were long. In 2024 we turned that problem into an online marketplace where families order every textbook in one place and have it delivered. It runs as a seasonal project, going live in the back-to-school window each year (18 Aug – 11 Sep in 2026).

How the project ran

Plan and buildStarted with a business plan, brought in developers to build the platform on WordPress, then filled it with products.
Design and contentWorked daily with a graphic designer over Slack to produce the product designs.
StakeholdersTook requests in live meetings, kept notes, and turned them into tasks and delivery.
PartnershipsAgreements with publishing houses and deals with courier services.
Team set-upOnboarded about 6 customer service officers in two remote shifts (08:00–16:00 and 16:00–24:00), coordinated through Slack channels.
Customer conversationsTracked in Meta Business Suite.
2024: Launch

The first platform went from plan to live in one week: business plan, developers, products, publishers, couriers, and a new remote customer service team.

2025: Scale

Improved every part of the service. Customer service grew to 12 people and a 10-person packaging team was added.

2026: Rebuild

Restructured into a more functional team: an AI chatbot under human supervision, customer support at 6, and 12–14 people across departments, 8 of them in packaging. Coordination moved on-site and live.

Outcome The live period ran according to plan and stakeholder requests, with many new team members coordinated and deliveries going smoothly. A lot of the work happened before and after the live dates.
